welcome.title: Getting started: check {product} works for you
welcome.body:
{product} is connected. Four steps, about five minutes:

1. Ask your AI: "Which of my machines can you reach?" It calls `machines` and lists each machine and whether it is online.
2. On your phone, open {hub}/approvals. Tap **Notify this phone**, then **Send me a test approval**. Approve it from the notification.
3. Ask your AI for something small on one machine, for example: "Show me the free disk space on <machine>." Anything you should sign off on waits for you on your phone.
4. Tell your AI it worked, and ask it to close this ticket.

Stuck on a step? Tell your AI which one; it can read this ticket.

access.waiting: You're on the {product} early-access list since {since}, and nothing runs for you here until you're in. You'll get an email when you're in. Your account: {account}
access.account_waiting: **You're on the early-access list** since {since}. You'll get an email when you're in; until then your AI can sign in and ask who it is, and nothing else runs. Secure your account below so the email reaches you.
access.account_admitted: You're in since {since}, on the **{plan}** plan.
access.limit: Your {plan} plan holds {limit} here, and you have {count}. The plans: {plans}

operator.title: Operator
operator.account_link: You run this hub: let people in and set their plans on the [operator page](/operator).
operator.status_open: Sign-up is **open**: everyone who connects is let in at once.
operator.status_early_access: Sign-up is **early access**: everyone who connects waits here until you let them in.
operator.how_to_change: To change it, set `early_access.mode` in the site's `site.json` to `open` or `early_access`, then run `hub-up.sh --site DIR --site-only`. Once it is open, people waiting are let in on their next request; nobody already in is ever put back.
operator.done_admitted: Let in: {n}. Their next call works.
operator.none_picked: Nobody was checked: check the people to let in, then press the button.
operator.not_from_here: That came from another site, so nothing was changed. Use the operator page itself.
operator.admitted_empty: Nobody has been let in yet.
